title: sweetcraft
description: did you know that the ice cream flavor "sweet cream" is very simillar to vanilla?
body:
sweet craft is a modpack that is close to vanilla focusing on improving armor and tool progression along with overhauling the 3 dimensions in minecraft

this modpack is **playable on mobile** via **Mojo launcher** but you will have to manually  change the rendering back to openGL

**NOTICE**

some of the things break when using shaders so thats why i didnt put iris in it

there is a bug currently that gives an advancement for crafting copper tools even though but it gives it to every tool not just copper

**PROGRESSION**

Smelt rotten flesh into leather and craft your leather armor!

compress copper in the crafting table and get your copper tools and armor
_maybe even wax the armor using a honeycomb to make it stronger_

craft chainmail using chains which now cost 3 iron nuggets

get iron the same old way but remember for each metal there are diffrent weapon types like Spears

u can craft bronze using tin and copper in a crafting table

the rest of the progression is pretty much the same
